catalysts.headline: Solstice announces Q3 2026 earnings date of November 4, 2026
Alongside the terminated Element Solutions merger, Solstice announced a $500M share buyback authorization; neither company paid a termination fee
Solstice and ESI mutually agreed to scrap their $14.5B merger
catalysts.impact: +12.76% on the close (+16% per one source)

catalysts.headline: Q2 2026: net sales $1,148M (+11% Y/Y), GAAP diluted EPS $0.75, adjusted diluted EPS $0.88 (beat ~$0.77-0.79 consensus); raised FY2026 guidance to net sales $4,125-4,185M, adjusted EBITDA $1,035-1,055M, adjusted diluted EPS $2.75-2.95

Solstice Advanced Materials agrees to acquire Element Solutions in a cash-and-stock deal valued at ~$14.5B (including assumed net debt); Element shareholders get $10 cash + 0.5 SOLS shares per ESI share; expected to close H1 2027
catalysts.impact: major; one source notes SOLS fell ~8.7% on the announcement (unconfirmed by a second source)

catalysts.headline: Solstice Advanced Materials completed its spin-off from Honeywell and began regular-way trading on Nasdaq under ticker SOLS; Honeywell shareholders received 1 SOLS share per 4 HON shares held (total distribution of 158,727,456 shares)
catalysts.impact: Company became an independent public company
